SPY.title: US Stocks Could Open On A Tentative Note; Nvidia, AMD And Toyota On Investors' Radar: Experts Flag Over Reliance On AI, Tech Stocks
SPY.description: U.S. stocks could open on a tentative note as investors remain cautious about the market's reliance on AI and tech stocks. Experts warn that this overreliance could lead to a market correction or a bear market in the Nasdaq if a market rotation to other sectors does not occur soon.
SPY.author: Benzinga Senior Editor
